name: Audio Stream
description: Streams Android microphone audio as AAC/ADTS over HTTP.
author: krie

settings.title: HTTP port
settings.description: TCP port for the AAC/ADTS stream (1024-65535). The stream path is /audio.aac.

settings.title: Input gain
settings.description: Digital microphone gain before AAC encoding. 0 dB leaves the signal unchanged; +6 dB is about 2x amplitude. High values can clip.
